purpose: Head-to-head comparison of the published DecoDiPhy heuristic with the frozen exact structural solver on identical stage-287 bank instances.

decodiphy.install: python3 -m venv; pip install . from the cloned repository

exact_solver.options: cap=case cap; seconds/max_states/max_bases/max_faces all None, as in the stage-44 confirmation protocol

methods.exact_stage43_partial: minimum number of sources within the case budget, exact rational arithmetic
methods.dd_default: documented defaults: hill climbing, quick neighbourhood radius 2, osqp, seed 1142, min_p 0.01, k selected by DecoDiPhy stopping rules
methods.dd_true_k: documented defaults plus -k K_true -f 1, i.e. exactly the generating number of placements
methods.dd_resolution: documented defaults plus --min_p 1e-12 -k K_true+3 -f 0, i.e. the tool's own near-zero-residue stop with the abundance stop effectively disabled

asymmetry_note: DecoDiPhy takes the number of placements as an input or selects it by stopping rules; the exact solver returns the minimum. The three arms cover its own selection, the oracle value of k, and its highest-resolution setting.
input_encoding: Exact rational edge lengths and observed distances are written to the Newick tree and the distance file as shortest round-trip doubles; DecoDiPhy is a floating-point tool. The exact solver reads the unrounded rationals.
